decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (568/01, Unnumbered method statement, received 06/08/2013, MOR/LIC/0039, received 16/09/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Not more than one boat shall be moored on the pontoon and shall only be used for private recreational purposes for the enjoyment of the occupiers of Morton House, Chiswick Mall and shall not be used for commercial purposes or as a houseboat unless prior written approval is granted by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a floating pontoon linked to the front garden of the property by a gangway
